CustomField.formula:
IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c , 'Client Manager'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c , 'Benefit Consultant'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c , 'UMR Client'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c , 'Surest Client Manager')),
IF(ISNULL(Override_Current_Weight_User__c), IF(NOT(ISNULL(Current_Weighting__c)),Current_Weighting__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c,0-CM_BOB_Weighting__c), Override_Current_Weight_User__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c),
IF( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c, 'Client Management Consultant'), IF(ISNULL(CMC_Override_Current_Weight__c), IF(NOT(ISNULL(CMC_Current_Weight__c)),CMC_Current_Weight__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c, 0-CM_BOB_Weighting__c), CMC_Override_Current_Weight__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c),
IF( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Role__c, 'Specialty Benefits Client Manager'), IF(ISNULL(SBC_Override_Current_Weighting__c), IF(NOT(ISNULL(SBC_Current_Weighting__c)),SBC_Current_Weighting__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c, 0-CM_BOB_Weighting__c), SBC_Override_Current_Weighting__c - CM_BOB_Weighting__c),0)))
